title: Interview WMF.ogv
author: Wikimedia Deutschland (WMDE)
preparation: Full interview converted from Theora/Vorbis to H.264/AAC at its original 1280x720 geometry and variable frame timing, CRF20/veryfast. No cuts or synthetic speech were added.
measured_workload: 15 separate clips, each with two ordered ranges totalling 9000 milliseconds; all 15 drafts followed by all 15 finals. Source upload and preparation precede the primary draft clock.
